csv_project_name: Engineering Services for Road 44 Sidewalk Infill
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Pasco (City), is soliciting a Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) from qualified Consultants registered in the State of Washington to provide professional engineering services for the design of the Road 44 sidewalk infill. The west side of Road 44 between W Argent Pl and the Road 44/Madison Ave roundabout is missing about 100 feet of sidewalk over the Franklin County Irrigation District s (FCID) canal. The missing link currently forces pedestrian traffic into the narrow roadway to cross the irrigation canal. Road 44 is a collector street with residential neighborhoods to the north and a newly built convenience store and gas station to the south. Road 44 also serves Ben Franklin Transit (BFT) route 225, with the nearest stop at the corner of Argent Road and Road 44.
